scope: Private #190 current_selection_cache_v1.py, four bytes per selective workspace. No production source changed.
producer: Only a freshly computed _check followed by guard_quality with selection.error==0 and core._accepted!=0 marks the current evaluation reusable.
consumer: Only VTMWorkspace._step calls select_current. Its Python context applies to select() graph recording only; conditional decisions use the device needed flag. Direct select/evaluate calls recompute.
lifetime: After _check accepts, _accept only recomputes ODT energy/mass/moments/edge statistics; controls.gate reads device controls and may stop the loop. Neither changes selection inputs, keep/quality/minimum/count, current domain data, roles, active prefix, recovery/exterior flags or extraction metadata before the next selection.
invalidation: Selection.reset before every fresh run, initial anchoring and initial reconstruction
Before every _try_step changes points and reconstructs
Every select-all transition before overwriting summary outputs
limits: This is an optimizer-owned intra-run lifetime. It does not authorize using select_current as a general cache after arbitrary external writes. Fresh public core.run resets the state, so producers can change inputs/counts/domain/controls between graph calls. Concurrent unordered input writes were never a supported operation.
evidence: 4 new forced-fresh oracle tests pass (v2 test fixture; v1 used unsupported float(string) in a Warp kernel and its failure is retained)
Two complete torus pairs pass independent exact CGAL global/hull, NumPy quality/AABB and boundary-link checks; points and work match bitwise/exactly.
